name: rn-monorepo
description: React Native Monorepo with shared packages and multiple apps

scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules && find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.build:shared: cd packages/shared && npm run build && cd ../..
scripts.build:ui: cd packages/ui && npm run build && cd ../..
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:shared && npm run build:ui
